book.name: Matiu
book.title: Cau Amsǝban a nê mala MATIU

content: Yesu twali ɓè mǝrǝwunarǝkwana male
Yesu pǝlǝa eauwe a waru, yàle a nkaring o a la male.
Aɓea aɓwana yinǝi wi nǝ ɓè mǝrǝwuna a kala. Lang Yesu sǝn gūliarǝu malea ka, ne mǝkwánó ama,

content.text: <<Nwangsǝ ɓabumo, munem, à twalǝno ban acauɓikea mò.>>

content: Aɓea amǝkani Nggurcau nea rǝia ama, <<Ɓwa mǝnia kǝ twal ɓamúrì ama yì ka, Ɓakuli na!>>
Acemǝnana Yesu súrǝ́nà rǝ ɗenyicau malea ka, banggia wia ama,

content.text: <<Palang sǝ wu kǝ pak ɗenyicau mǝɓane a ɓabum wun anggo?
Mǝ ye na kwano kútì ɓì: ɓǝà na ama, <À twalǝno ban acauɓikea mô> le, ko ɓǝà na ama, <Lo gya?>
Sǝ ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu sǝlǝ ama Muna mala Ɓwa ka ndanǝ rǝcandǝa a ɓanza nǝ̀ twalban acauɓikea ka, mǝ nǝ lǝmdǝa wun.>>

content: Pǝlǝa Yesu pǝlǝa aban mǝrǝwuna sǝ ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Lo kar kala mô o a ɓala mò.>>

content: Sǝ ɓwabure par buì lo o a ɓala.
Aɓwana mana à ram ngga, ɓangciu pakkia wia arǝ gir mana à sǝn ngga. À ɓwangsǝ Ɓakuli mǝnana pè aɓwana-mǝpǝndǝe ulang man yì rǝcandǝa ka.
Yesu tunǝ Matiu ɓǝ̀ kpate
Yesu puro nǝ̀ kútí ka yi sǝn ɓeɓwa mana à tunǝki ama Matiu mǝ'ak boalo-cemi, aban do aɓa tara ak boalo-cemi. Yesu ne wi ama,
Kara lo o atà Yesu.
Lang Yesu na ban li a ɓala ka, amǝ'aki aboalo-cemi pas andǝ aɓea aɓwana mana amǝ Farisi twalia amǝ'cauɓikea na ka, à yì do atà Yesu andǝ alaggana male a ban li.
Sǝ amǝ Farisi sǝn Yesu aban li andǝ aɓwana mǝnia ka, à ɗì alaggana male ama, <<Ace man sǝ ɓwamǝgule ma'wun kǝ lili andǝ amǝ'ak boalo-cemi andǝ amǝ'cauɓikea?>>
Yesu nǝ̀ ok man yì cau ka pǝlǝa earia wia ama,

content.text: <<Aɓwana mǝnana rǝia bang ngga kǝgìr oasǝia arǝ mǝsonzǝo ɗang; amǝkwánó na à alkiyita mǝpaɓuri ka.
Wu kyane wu kya bǝl ɓá mǝnia yì nggurcau mana ama: <Sǝn mǝsǝswatǝr na ǝn earkiyice ka, pà gìr'nkila na ɗang.> Ən yiu ace tunǝ amǝ'cauɓoarna ɗang, nda ace amǝ'cauɓikea.>>

content: Aɓwana ɗì Yesu amur gilmùr
Àkǝ̀ pwari mǝno ka alaggana mala Yohana Mǝbatisǝma yiu a ban Yesu sǝ à ɗì ama, <<Man tsǝa sǝ sǝm sǝnǝ amǝ Farisi ka, sǝm nggǝ gilmùr sǝ alaggana mo ka à kǝ gilmùr ɗàng?>>
Yesu nyesǝia wia ama:

content.text: Lang sǝ agyajam mala bura-māfela nǝ̀ pak bumkiɗikea mǝnana nda a bania peatu ka? Pwari nǝ̀ nggá yiu à nǝ̀ yia twal bura-māfela a rǝia; a pwarî sǝ à nǝ̀ gilmùr.
Kǝ ɓwa pà nǝ̀ kpakǝri eakǝna daura nǝ kasǝna nggubyau mǝbǝshe ɗàng. Ɓǝa pa anggo ka kasǝne mǝbǝshe nǝ̀ yia tsǝk eakǝna daurae nǝ̀ san kpǝm nǝ̀ wori man ɗiɗyal ka.

Sǝ ɗǝm ngga, kǝɓwa pà nǝ̀ so bǝsa mùr-anap aɓalǝ asambǝram mǝ'e ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ soe ka asambǝrami nǝ̀ arkia, sǝ mùr-anap ni nǝ̀ sukkio, sǝ asambǝrami nǝ̀ ueɓà. Bǝsa mùr-anap ka à kǝ soe aɓalǝ asambǝram mǝbǝshe. Anggo sǝ yia kǝm ngga à nǝ̀ àwá.

content: Yesu loasǝ lú sǝ twalban rǝkwana

Lang Yesu na ban nea wia amǝnia yì acau ka, ɓè ɓwamǝgule ndakpapi mala amǝ Yahudi yiu yi kū`ndǝó a ɓadǝmbi, ne wi ama, <<Ɓoarnsarilem wu àkǝ̀ dyadyan. Yiu tsǝk buo arǝì, sǝ mǝsǝì nǝ̀ sa nǝ̀ pak yilǝmu.>>
Yesu pǝlǝa lo o atè, andǝ alaggana male.
Nǝ̀ nggǝ ká ka, ɓè ɓwama mǝnana nkila kǝ kángí arǝì apǝlǝkia lum-nong-ɓari ka, kar a nzǝmi yi je kun daura male.
Ne ɓamúrì ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ mǝ nǝ kumô mǝ je daura male ka, rǝam nǝ̀ málâ.>>
Yesu pǝlǝ rǝì sǝni, sǝ ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Ɓwama, ɓangciu ɓǝ̀ kǝa pakko ɗàng! Gūliarǝu mo arǝàm twalǝno ban kwánó mo.>>

content: Àkǝ̀ banì mǝno sǝ rǝ ɓwame málá.
Kutio mala Yesu a ɓala mala mǝno yì ɓwamǝgule ka, yi sǝn amǝ'twang ntetu andǝ aɓwana mana à ramba à kǝ ɓua ka.
Pǝlǝa nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Wu mǝsǝe! Ɓoarnsarile wu nǝ wú ɗang. Nda a ntulo.>>

content: Kara à oali nǝ oalo.
Lang à tsǝ̀ngŋǝ̀nà aɓwana à purna a nza ka, Yesu kutio bwal ɓoarnsarile a garabui, sǝ lo dumnǝdo.
Mǝnia yì cau ka akiban kat aɓa mǝno yì bu-nzali ka.
Yesu mǝn mǝsǝ ante
Yesu purni ban mǝno nǝ̀ nggǝ o ka, aɓea ante ɓari lo aban ká atè. À loasǝ già ama, <<Muna mala Dauda
, ɓwamur sǝm!>>
Lang Yesu kutina a ɓala ka, ante mǝnia yiu a baní, sǝ ɗia ama,

content.text: <<Wu earǝna nǝi ama mǝ nǝ gandǝ mǝn amǝsǝ wun le?>>

content: À eare ama, <<E, Mǝtalabangŋo!>>
Pǝlǝa je mǝsǝia sǝ na ama,

content.text: <<Kǝla mǝnana wu earǝna nǝi ka ɓǝ̀ dupa wun anggo.>>

content: Àkǝ̀ banì, mǝsǝia mǝna. Sǝ Yesu nunkiria pepè ama,
Sǝa ma à puro à kya mesǝ ce Yesu a bu-nzali mǝno kat.
Yesu tsǝk mǝtalasǝ-ɓunna nacau
À nda ban puro à nǝ̀ o ka, aɓea ɓwana yiu nǝ ɓeɓwa mǝnana kukwar kutia rǝì sǝ kǝ gandǝ nacau raka aban Yesu.
Yesu pusǝ kukwar mǝnana arǝì ka, àkǝ̀ banì ɓwa mǝnana kǝ gandǝ nacau ɗiɗyal raka, tita nacau. Ɓwabunda ndali sǝ à na ama, <<Sǝm malaká sǝn kǝgìr kǝla man aɓa Isǝrayila ɗàng.>>
Sǝ amǝ Farisi ka à yi bang ama nǝ murǝm mala akukwar sǝ Yesu kǝ pusǝki akukwar.
Yesu sǝn mǝsǝswatǝrmala aɓwana
Yesu gya arǝ anggea-là andǝ amuna-là kat, aban kanigir aɓalǝ andakpapi mala amǝ Yahudi, kǝ hamnǝ Cau Amsǝban mala Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli, sǝ kǝ twalban akwánó andǝ arǝpangŋa kat.
Lang yi sǝn làkkì mala aɓwabundǝa ka, mǝsǝswatǝr malea pakki wi, acemǝnana à nda aɓa tanni. Kǝ mǝpyaumǝsǝu pa amúrià ɗàng, kǝla anzur mǝnana yalu pa amúrià raka.
Pǝlǝa ne alaggana male ama,

content.text: <<Túró Wal-mǝsa ka nda kpǝm, sǝ amǝtúró làkkì ɗàng.
Wu zǝmbi Mǝtala-ɓaban ɓǝ̀ tasǝ amǝtúró ɓǝà yiu a ɓaban male.>>
